```{r setup, include = FALSE}
## Setting up document
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE,
                      message = FALSE,

```

```{r}
## Loading packages
library(pacman)
p_load(qualtRics, janitor, stargazer, pander, printy, emmeans, plotrix, 
       lme4, tidyverse)
```

```{r}
## Setting options for viewing summary tables
options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)
```

```{r}
## Reading in raw data
se4 <- read_survey("SE4_Data.csv")
```

```{r}
## Cleaning
se4_clean <- se4 %>% 
  clean_names() %>%
  filter(finished == 1,
         is.na(age) == FALSE,
         is.na(political_leanings) == TRUE) %>%  
  rename(frame = condition) %>% 
  mutate(id = row_number(),
         prev_fix_con = case_when(frame == "prevent" ~ -1, frame == "fix" ~ 1),
         pref_snap = rowSums(across(c(snap_prevent, snap_fix)), na.rm = T),
         pref_voterid = rowSums(across(c(voterid_prevent, voterid_fix)), na.rm = T),
         pref_stimchecks = rowSums(across(c(stimchecks_prevent, stimchecks_fix)), na.rm = T),
         pref_studentloans = rowSums(across(c(studentloans_prevent, studentloans_fix)), na.rm = T),
         pref_immigration = rowSums(across(c(immigration_prevent, immigration_fix)), na.rm = T)) %>% 
  select(id, frame, prev_fix_con, starts_with("pref_"), gender, age)
```

```{r}
se4_clean_long <- se4_clean %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(pref_snap, pref_voterid, pref_stimchecks, 
                        pref_studentloans, pref_immigration),
               names_to = "scenario",
               names_prefix = "pref_",
               values_to = "pref")
```

\clearpage

# Sample

```{r}
## Collecting descriptives
pct_male = round((sum(se4_clean$gender == 1)/nrow(se4_clean))*100, 2)
pct_female = round((sum(se4_clean$gender == 2)/nrow(se4_clean))*100, 2)
pct_nonbinary = round((sum(se4_clean$gender == 3)/nrow(se4_clean))*100, 2)
mean_age = round(mean(se4_clean$age), 2)
sd_age = round(sd(se4_clean$age), 2)
```


We aimed to recruit 800 U.S. MTurk workers via CloudResearch for this study.

Participants from the raw Qualtrics data were only included in this analysis if they completed the survey in its entirety and passed a preregistered attention check, leaving us with `r nrow(se4_clean)` participants (`r pct_female`% female, `r pct_male`% male, `r pct_nonbinary`% nonbinary; Mean~Age~ = `r mean_age`, SD~Age~ = `r sd_age`).

\clearpage

# Means

```{r}
## Collecting means
se4_clean_long %>% 
  rename(Frame = frame,
         Scenario = scenario) %>% 
  mutate(Frame = recode(Frame, prevent = "Prevent", fix = "Fix"),
         Scenario = recode(Scenario, snap = "SNAP Benefits",
                           voterid = "Voter ID Laws", 
                           stimchecks = "Stimulus Checks",
                           studentloans = "Student Loan Forgiveness",
                           immigration = "Immigration Visas"),
         Scenario = factor(Scenario, levels = c("SNAP Benefits", 
                                                "Voter ID Laws",
                                                "Stimulus Checks",
                                                "Student Loan Forgiveness", 
                                                "Immigration Visas"))) %>%
  group_by(Scenario, Frame) %>% 
  summarize("Mean Prop. Addressing FNs" = round(mean(pref), 2),
            "Std. Error" = round(std.error(pref), 2),
            "CI - Lower" = round((mean(pref) - (1.96*std.error(pref))), 2),
            "CI - Upper" = round((mean(pref) + (1.96*std.error(pref))), 2),
            "N" = n()) %>% 
  arrange(Scenario, desc(Frame)) %>% 
  pander(caption = "Means by Frame (Note that 0 = FP and 1 = FN)",
         split.table = Inf)
```

\clearpage

## Regression

```{r}
m1 <- glmer(pref ~ prev_fix_con + (1 | id) + (1 | scenario), data = se4_clean_long, 
            family = binomial)
```

```{r, results = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
## Main results
summary(m1)

## 95% CIs
confint(m1, method = "Wald", parm = "beta_")
```

```{r}
## Collecting more details on the coefficient of interest
ixn_or <- round(exp(coef(summary(m1))[2]), 2)
```

We are primarily interested in the effect of frame, and the odds ratio for this term (which we will use as a measure of effect size) is `r ixn_or`.

\clearpage

# Chi Square Tests

## SNAP Benefits

```{r, results = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
chisq.test(se4_clean$pref_snap, se4_clean$frame, correct = F)
```
## Voter ID Laws

```{r, results = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
chisq.test(se4_clean$pref_voterid, se4_clean$frame, correct = F)
```

## Stimulus Checks

```{r, results = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
chisq.test(se4_clean$pref_stimchecks, se4_clean$frame, correct = F)
```

## Student Loan Forgiveness

```{r, results = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
chisq.test(se4_clean$pref_studentloans, se4_clean$frame, correct = F)
```

## Immigration Visas

```{r, results = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
chisq.test(se4_clean$pref_immigration, se4_clean$frame, correct = F)
```
